definitions.explanation: Doing something without meaning to; an action that happens reflexively or without conscious intention.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}わず⟦{笑|わら}ってしまった→笑う：00685_warau⟧。

examples.english: Seeing his face, I involuntarily cried.

examples.japanese: ⟦おいしそうで→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧{思|おも}わず⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びた→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: It looked so delicious that I involuntarily reached for it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{懐|なつ}かしい→懐かしい：02484_natsukashii⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、{思|おも}わず⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Seeing the nostalgic photo, tears came to my eyes involuntarily.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧{思|おも}わず「⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧！」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}ってしまった→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I saw the price and couldn't help saying "Expensive\!"

notes:
{思|おも}わず means 'unintentionally' or 'involuntarily.' It describes actions done without conscious intention.

ETYMOLOGY:
- From ⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to think) + ず (classical negative)
- Literally: 'without thinking'

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {思|おも}わず〜⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦しまう→しまう：03064_shimau⟧ (to end up doing ~ unintentionally)
- {思|おも}わず⟦{笑|わら}う→笑う：00685_warau⟧ (to laugh involuntarily)
- {思|おも}わず⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to cry out unintentionally)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦つい→つい：02564_tsui⟧: 'inadvertently, carelessly'
- ⟦うっかり→うっかり：01863_ukkari⟧: 'carelessly, by mistake'
- {思|おも}わず: emphasizes the involuntary nature of the action

POSITION: Usually appears right before the verb it modifies.
